symbols.name: input length in bits
symbols.meaning: The count of bits in each input of the machine, the length in bits of each input.
symbols.quote: Here $n$ is the length in bits of each input.

symbols.name: fixed exponent saving
symbols.meaning: A fixed constant equal to $2^{-182}$, the same for every input length $n$.
symbols.quote: The theorem also bounds its worst-case time by a constant times $n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa}$, where $\kappa = 2^{-182}$ is a fixed constant, the same for every $n$.
